title: Canadian Burger
description: A classic Canadian burger recipe with a juicy patty, melted cheese, and a hint of Canadian flavor.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef and burger patty seasoning. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
3. Divide the beef mixture into 4 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball. Flatten each ball slightly into a patty.
4. Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 160°F.
5. Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the grill or in a toaster.
6. Assemble the burgers with the grilled patties, Canadian bacon, cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, mayonnaise, and ketchup.
